item.g:title: Manuka Honey UMF 20+ jar + Manuka Honey UMF 5+ jar
item.g:description: 🏆 Ordered more than 80 times This offer brings together two jars of genuine New Zealand Manuka honey : a UMF 20+ jar and a UMF 5+ jar, 250 g each, produced by the New Zealand company HoneyBros, a member of the Manuka honey producers' association UMFHA. 🍯 Quick facts Two jars: UMF 20+ (250 g) and UMF 5+ (250 g), 500 g total. Manuka honey with no additives, imported from New Zealand. Produced by HoneyBros, a member of the New Zealand UMFHA. Every batch is independently tested to confirm authenticity. Returns accepted within 7 days of receiving the order. 📖 Product story and origin Manuka honey is produced in New Zealand from the nectar of the wild Manuka tree. HoneyBros packs both jars of this offer inside New Zealand, and every batch is independently tested to confirm authenticity, to the standards set by the New Zealand UMFHA, the body responsible for testing and grading Manuka honey. 😋 Taste and use A strong, distinctive taste with a dark colour and thick texture unlike ordinary flower honey. Enjoy it at breakfast with bread or pancakes, with tea or coffee, or as a gift for guests. 📦 Storage Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, and close the lid tightly after each use to keep its texture and aroma. Spec Detail First jar Manuka honey UMF 20+, 250 g Second jar Manuka honey UMF 5+, 250 g Origin New Zealand Brand Honey Bros ❓ FAQ Is this genuine Manuka honey? Yes, imported from New Zealand from HoneyBros, a UMFHA member, and every batch is independently tested. What is the difference between UMF 20+ and UMF 5+? UMF measures the strength of Manuka honey — the higher the number, the stronger it is, so the UMF 20+ jar is stronger than the UMF 5+ jar. Can I return the product? Yes, returns are accepted within 7 days of receiving the order. Is this honey suitable for infants? Honey should not be given to infants under 12 months; it is suitable for anyone older.
